During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''battle''' was fought on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] of [[Polomie]]. The battle was fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="entry" /> sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="data" /> The battle was used as the first field test for the Empire's [[Nemesis-class gunship|''Nemesis''-class gunship]]. The [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used its [[Hellcaster cannon]] and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] during the battle, and the noise created by its jets proved beneficial to the Empire. The loud sound had a major effect on the Rebel's morale, causing many of them to flee in terror. The gunship fulfilled the mission with only minor damage, and at some point after the battle, [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]]-[[General/Legends|General]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rebu]] gave a report about the gunship's mission to the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]]. He was impressed by the gunship's performance, stating that it had exceeded all expectations.<ref name="entry" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle fought on Polomie was first mentioned in "The ''Nemesis'' Gunship" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].<ref name="entry" />
